audits.notes: First audit, on the 19-trial test set (kept out of the public dataset). Of 100 numbers marked verified, 96 were correct: 81 compared with hand-checked values (79 correct), 18 picked at random (17 correct) and 1 found by a new check (wrong). 16 review-queue items were also judged. Systematic error: non-standard time endpoints (second PFS, PFS on treatment, failure-free survival, duration of disease control) filed as PFS or TTP; fixed with a new measure and a code check.
